bags.title: Bags
bags.editorial_html:
About our leather bags

Every Mavelania bag begins as a full hide of genuine leather. Panels are cut by hand so the grain runs the way it should across the front, seams are stitched to carry weight rather than just to close a shape, and edges are sealed and burnished instead of left raw.

Because leather is a natural material, no two bags are identical. Grain, pore structure and tone shift from hide to hide, and a bag darkens and softens along the lines where it is handled most. Ours are made to be used.

Choosing and caring

Dimensions are listed on each product page so you can check a bag against what you carry daily. To care for it, wipe the surface with a soft dry cloth and keep alcohol, perfume and detergent away from the leather. If it gets wet, blot without rubbing and let it dry at room temperature, away from direct heat.
bags.seo_description: Handcrafted leather bags from Mavelania — totes, shoulder bags, clutches and briefcases, cut from genuine leather and finished by hand. 14-day returns.

card_holders.description: A reserved edit from the new leather card holder collection.
card_holders.editorial_html:
About our leather card holders

A card holder is the answer to carrying less. Ours are cut from genuine leather and built flat, so the piece stays slim in a back pocket or an inside jacket pocket rather than forming a wedge. Slots are sized so cards sit securely but come out with one thumb, and edges are sealed by hand.

Models with RFID protection include a shielding layer that stops contactless cards transmitting while they are inside. This is stated clearly on the product page for the models that have it — it is not on every model.

What to expect

A new card holder is firm and loosens over the first weeks as the leather takes the shape of what you carry. Grain and tone vary between pieces because they are cut from natural hide.
card_holders.seo_description: Slim genuine leather card holders by Mavelania, hand-finished with burnished edges and built for everyday carry. 14-day returns.

phone_cases.description: Discover leather phone cases designed for everyday use.
phone_cases.title: Phone Cases
phone_cases.editorial_html:
About our leather phone cases

A phone is picked up more often than anything else in a day, which makes it an unusually good object to wrap in leather. Ours are cut and finished by hand from genuine leather, with cutouts aligned to the ports and camera and edges sealed so the case does not peel along the corners where it is gripped.

Some models combine the case with card slots, so a phone and two or three cards travel together without a separate wallet.

How it ages

Leather here shows use faster than on any other piece, because it is in your hand constantly. It darkens where your fingers rest and softens at the corners. Wipe it with a dry cloth; keep it away from alcohol-based cleaners and hand sanitiser, which strip the finish.
phone_cases.seo_description: Leather iPhone cases by Mavelania — folio, magnetic and card-holder styles in genuine leather that softens and develops a patina with daily use.

accessories.description: Discover the finishing pieces in the Mavelania accessories collection.
accessories.title: Accessories
accessories.editorial_html:
About our leather accessories

These are the finishing pieces of the collection — the smaller leather goods that sit alongside a bag or a wallet rather than replacing them. Each is made from the same genuine leather and finished by the same hand processes as the larger pieces: cut, constructed, edges sealed and burnished.

The range stays deliberately small. A piece is added when it earns a place in daily use, not to fill out a category.

Materials and care

All pieces are genuine leather, so variation in grain and tone between items is expected. Clean with a soft dry cloth and avoid alcohol, perfume, wet wipes and detergent.
accessories.seo_description: Leather accessories from Mavelania — bag charms, bookmarks, desk mats and jewelry boxes, made from the same genuine hides as our bags. 14-day returns.

wallets.description: A reserved edit from the new leather wallets and purses collection.
wallets.title: Wallets / Purses
wallets.editorial_html:
About our leather wallets and purses

A wallet is handled more than anything else you own, so it is the hardest test of how a piece is built. Ours are cut from genuine leather, with card slots sized to hold without stretching and edges finished so they do not fray in a pocket. The construction stays slim deliberately: a wallet should keep its shape after a year, not spread into the outline of whatever was forced into it.

Models that include RFID protection carry a shielding layer that blocks contactless cards from transmitting until you take them out. Where that layer is present it is stated on the product page.

How it ages

Genuine leather develops a patina: the surface darkens slightly, the finish softens, and the folds settle into the way you use it. Small differences in tone and grain between two wallets of the same model are normal and come from the hide, not from the making.

faq.a_care: Wipe the surface gently with a soft, dry cloth. Do not apply alcohol, perfume, wet wipes, detergent or harsh chemicals directly to the leather. If you use a leather-care product, test it first on a small, hidden area.
faq.a_change: Contact our support team as soon as possible before your order begins preparation. The possibility of a change or cancellation depends on the current order status and cannot be guaranteed.
faq.a_contact: Email our support team with questions about a product, care or your order.
faq.a_handmade: Yes. Mavelania products are handcrafted from genuine leather. Cutting, construction and edge finishing are completed with care according to each design. Small differences created by handwork are part of the individual character of every piece.
faq.a_international: International delivery availability and shipping cost are shown at checkout. Customs duties or import charges may apply under the destination country's rules; unless checkout states otherwise, these charges may be the recipient's responsibility.
faq.a_payment: Payments are processed through secure payment infrastructure supported by Shopify. Available methods are shown at checkout according to your country and currency. Mavelania does not directly store your card details.
faq.a_returns: The return period, unused-condition requirement and other terms are explained in our current refund policy. We recommend reviewing the applicable policy before placing an order.
faq.a_rfid: RFID is an automatic identification technology that can transmit information using radio frequencies. Contactless cards and certain identity documents may use this type of communication. An RFID-blocking layer adds a physical precaution by attenuating radio signals while a card is inside the closed, protected compartment.
faq.a_rfid_models: RFID protection is included only in wallet and card holder models where the feature is clearly stated in the product description. It does not prevent every wireless threat, loss of a card or online fraud, and should not be treated as a complete replacement for good card security.
faq.a_shipping: Current preparation and delivery information is shown at checkout and in the order confirmation. A separate timeframe is stated on the product page for handcrafted or pre-order items when applicable. Tracking details are sent by email when available after dispatch.
faq.a_variations: Yes. Genuine leather is a natural material, so small differences in grain, pores, tone and surface markings may occur. They are not manufacturing defects but part of the leather's natural character. The patina that develops over time also makes each piece personal.
faq.a_water: Blot excess moisture with a clean cloth without rubbing and allow the product to dry naturally at room temperature. Do not use a hair dryer, radiator or direct sunlight. When not in use, store it in a dry, ventilated place while supporting its shape.

about.title: Handcrafted Leather Goods
about.lede: Mavelania makes leather goods by hand — bags, wallets, card holders, phone cases and the small pieces that go with them. One material, worked properly, in shapes meant to be carried every day.
about.figure_leather_alt: Mavelania leather wallets and card holders
about.figure_craft_alt: A bordeaux leather bag from the Mavelania collection
about.material_body: We work in genuine leather. It is a natural material, so no two hides are identical — grain, pores and tone shift from one piece to the next, and the same model can read slightly differently in two people's hands. That is not a flaw to be corrected. It is why leather is worth using: it takes on the marks of the person carrying it and becomes theirs.
about.craft_body: Cutting, construction and edge finishing are done by hand. Edges are sealed and burnished rather than left raw, seams are stitched to hold under daily load, and hardware is set so it stays quiet in use. This is slower than machine production and it is the reason our range stays small.
about.rfid_body: RFID is a technology that lets a card transmit information over radio frequency. Our wallet and card holder models that carry RFID protection include a shielding layer that blocks that transmission until you take the card out. Not every model includes it — where it is present, it is stated on the product page.
about.make_body: The collection is organised by what a piece is for rather than by season. Nothing is released to fill a calendar.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lede: The quickest way to reach us is email — write to info@mavelania.com and a person will read it. You can also message us on any of our social accounts. Questions about a product, an order, leather care or anything else are all welcome.
contact.success: Thank you — your message has reached us. We will reply to the address you gave.
contact.hours_body: We answer messages within two business days. Orders already in preparation move quickly, so if you need to change or cancel one, say so in the first line and we will prioritise it.
contact.direct_body: info@mavelania.com is the main channel for orders, returns, product questions and wholesale enquiries. It reaches us directly.
contact.elsewhere_body: We reply to direct messages on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn. For anything involving an order number, email is faster and keeps a record.
